Bike lanes make New York City streets safer and more accessible for cyclists. The Department of Transportation (DOT) maintains and installs on-street bicycle lanes.

Bike Lane Maintenance Issue

You can report a maintenance issue with a bike lane. 

Visit the following pages to report a bike lane that:

  • Has a pothole or cave-in
  • Has a street repair defect
  • Has a street plate condition
  • Is blocked by street construction
  • Needs resurfacing
  • Needs pavement markings
  • Has trash or debris

Request a New Bike Lane or Provide Feedback

You can contact DOT online or by mail to:

  • Request a new bicycle lane
  • Provide feedback about an existing bike route or car-free greenway
